description: KNM (Kennis van de Nederlandse Maatschappij) practice questions in Dutch, like the real exam. action 'next' returns a question with lettered choices (optionally by theme), without the answer. action 'answer' with question_id and the user's letter returns whether it is right, with an explanation. Each answer also returns a short progress value that holds this conversation's answer count; passed back as progress, the count continues. Free sample of Kora's KNM bank.

action.description: 'next' for a new question, 'answer' to check the user's choice.

choice.description: For 'answer': the user's letter, A, B or C.

progress.description: The progress value from the latest practice result in this conversation, if there is one. It holds only answer counts.

question_id.description: For 'answer' (or to fetch a specific question with 'next'): the question id.

theme.description: Optional theme for 'next', e.g. healthcare, work, housing, government.

name: practice
title: Practice KNM exam questions
